title: Audience Evidence Target
description: Experimental (media_buy.audience_evidence_targets). An audience the buyer wants evidence for. Satisfied only by an admissible audience_evidence item with an exactly matching audience, the same relationship, and value >= minimum_value. Planning and ranking input, never a targeting predicate. Matching rules: get_products docs.

audience.description: Compared to audience_evidence[].audience as an exact canonical key (label ignored).

relationship.description: Only evidence with the same relationship is compared.

minimum_value.description: Smallest satisfying evidence value: a fraction for composition, a ratio for index, an integer count for reach_estimate.
